feature_name: Private origin authentication for Amazon S3 origins
summary: Cloud CDN now supports private origin authentication for Amazon S3 and compatible object stores to allow only trusted connections.
extended_definition: Cloud CDN now supports private origin authentication for Amazon S3 and compatible object stores to allow only trusted connections.

supporting_pages.title: "Configure private origin authentication \_|\_ Cloud CDN \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: If necessary, update to the latest version of the Google Cloud CLI: gcloud components update Configure authentication for private origins To configure private origin authentication, use the following instructions: Console In the Google Cloud console, go to the Cloud CDN page.
Private origin authentication gives Cloud CDN long-term resource access to private Amazon S3 buckets or other compatible object stores.
Private origin authentication limits non-CDN access to your origins and content.
